reason: This passage from Joshua 9 recounts the Gibeonites' deception and the subsequent covenant made with them. While the text includes complaints from the Israelite congregation against their leaders (וַיִּלֹּנוּ כָל־ הָעֵדָה עַל־ הַנְּשִׂיאִים) over the deceptive treaty, there is no recorded speech or statement from Yahweh expressing complaint about the people. The passage focuses on human negotiations, Joshua's judgment of the Gibeonites, and the leaders' defense of their oath. Yahweh does not voice disapproval in this text fragment.
